title: Inspect read quality, trim and align

goals.title: Summarize per-cycle base quality
goals.why: Average quality across an entire run can hide the lower quality at read ends.
explain: Calculate mean Phred Q separately at each cycle, treating absent positions in short reads as missing, not zero.

The inputs are deliberately synthetic for practice; matching an expected result does not validate a biological interpretation.

goals.title: Trim trailing low-quality bases
goals.why: Poor-quality read ends can degrade downstream alignment and k-mer summaries.
explain: Walk backward from the last base until a Q >= threshold; retain internal low-quality bases until explicitly cleaned by another policy.
Removing all low-Q positions independently changes sequence coordinates and breaks read/quality correspondence.
The inputs are deliberately synthetic for practice; matching an expected result does not validate a biological interpretation.

worked_example.code:
seq='ACGTT';q=[35,35,35,7,4];n=len(q)
while n and q[n-1]<20:n-=1
print(seq[:n])
